segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Today, I want to talk about self-regulatory focus theory and how the actions of leaders can affect the way followers approach different situations.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Self-regulatory focus theory is a theory developed by Tori Higgins.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: He says that a person’ focus at any given time is to either approach pleasure or avoid pain.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: These are two basic motivations that each and every one of us has, and they cause us to have different kinds of goals.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Promotion goals in different life situations emphasise achievement [[ ]] .

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Prevention goals are oriented towards the avoidance of punishment.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: In a specific situation, our thoughts might focus more on promotion goals or more on prevention goals.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: The theory suggests that two factors affect which goals we are focusing on.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: First, there is a chronic factor.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: This factor is connected to a person’s personality [[ ]] and says that each person has a basic tendency to either focus more on promotion goals or focus more on prevention goals as part of his or her personality.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Second, there is a situational factor which means that the context we are in can make us more likely to focus on one set of goals or the other [[ ]] .

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: For example, we are more likely to be thinking about pleasure and to have promotion goals when we are spending time with a friend [[ ]] .

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: In contrast, if we are working on an important project for our boss, we are more likely to try to avoid making mistakes and therefore have more prevention goals in our mind.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Research has shown that the goals we are focusing on at a given time affect the way we think.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: For example, when focusing on promotion goals, people consider their ideal self, their aspirations and gains [[ ]] .

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: They don’t think about what they can lose, so they think in a happier mode.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: They feel more inspired to change.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: When people are focusing on prevention goals, they think about their “ought” self.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: What are they supposed to be?

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: What are people expecting from them?

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: They consider their obligations to others.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: As a result, they experience more anxiety and try to avoid situations where they could lose. ———————– Now that I have talked about the two focuses and how they affect people, I want to look at the idea that the way leaders behave, or their style of leading, can affect the focus that followers adopt in a specific situation [[ ]] .

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: In talking about leadership, we often mention transformational leaders and transactional leaders.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Transformational leaders, when interacting with their followers, focus on their development [[ ]] .

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: In their words and actions transformational leaders highlight change.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Their speech is passionate and conveys a definitive vision [[ ]] .

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: All of these things can encourage followers to think about what could be.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: In other words, they inspire a promotion focus in their followers.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: In contrast, transactional leaders focus on developing clear structures that tell their followers exactly what is expected of them [[ ]] .

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: While they do explain the rewards people will get for following orders, they emphasise more how a follower will be punished or that a follower won’t get rewarded if his or her behaviour doesn’t change.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: In short, they emphasise the consequences of making a mistake.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: This emphasis will clearly lead followers to focus on avoiding punishment and problems.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: This is clearly a prevention focus.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: In conclusion, it is important to understand that one focus is not necessarily better than the other one.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: For a designer who works in a field where a lot of innovation [[ ]] is needed, a promotion focus is probably better.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: In contrast, a prevention focus which causes people to work more cautiously and produce higher quality work might be very appropriate for a job like a surgeon, for example.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: The main point of the research, though, is that the actions of leaders can greatly influence whether people approach a situation with more of a promotion focus or more of a prevention focus.
